mn60:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena sālā nāma kosalānaṃ brāhmaṇagāmo tadavasari.
mn60:2.2: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhu saṅghena saddhiṃ sālaṃ anuppatto.
mn60:2.3: taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato:
mn60:2.4: itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
mn60:2.5: so imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti.
mn60:2.6: so dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ, kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
mn60:2.7: sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotī’ti.
mn60:3.1: atha kho sāleyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā appekacce bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. appekacce bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu. sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. appekacce yena bhagavā tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. appekacce bhagavato santike nāmagottaṃ sāvetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. appekacce tuṇhībhūtā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinne kho sāleyyake brāhmaṇagahapatike bhagavā etadavoca:
mn60:4.1: atthi pana vo gahapatayo koci manāpo satthā yasmiṃ vo ākāravatī saddhā paṭiladdhāti.
mn60:4.2: natthi kho no bhante, koci manāpo satthā, yasmiṃ no ākāravatī saddhā paṭiladdhāti.
mn60:4.3: manāpaṃ vo gahapatayo, satthāraṃ alabhantehi ayaṃ apaṇṇako dhammo samādāya vattitabbo.
mn60:4.4: apaṇṇako hi gahapatayo dhammo samatto samādinno, so vo bhavissati dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya.
mn60:5.1: santi gahapatayo, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino:
mn60:5.2: natthi dinnaṃ, natthi yiṭṭhaṃ, natthi hutaṃ, natthi sukaṭadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko, natthi ayaṃ loko, natthi paro loko, natthi mātā, natthi pitā, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammaggatā sammāpaṭipannā ye imañca lokaṃ parañca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentīti.
mn60:6.1: tesaṃyeva kho gahapatayo, samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā ujuvipaccanīkavādā.
mn60:6.3: atthi dinnaṃ, atthi yiṭṭhaṃ, atthi hutaṃ, atthi sukaṭadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko, atthi ayaṃ loko, atthi paro loko, atthi mātā, atthi pitā, atthi sattā opapātikā, atthi loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammaggatā sammā paṭipannā ye imañca lokaṃ parañca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentīti.
mn60:7.1: tatra gahapatayo, ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino
mn60:7.2: natthi dinnaṃ, natthi yiṭṭhaṃ, natthi hutaṃ, natthi sukaṭadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko, natthi ayaṃ loko, natthi paro loko, natthi mātā, natthi pitā, natthi sattā opapātikā, natthi loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammaggatā sammā paṭipannā ye imañca lokaṃ parañca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentīti.
mn60:7.3: tesametaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ: yamidaṃ kāyasucaritaṃ, vacīsucaritaṃ, manosucaritaṃ, ime tayo kusale dhamme abhinivajjetvā yamidaṃ kāyaduccaritaṃ, vacīduccaritaṃ, manoduccaritaṃ, ime tayo akusale dhamme samādāya vattissanti.
mn60:7.5: na hi te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā passanti akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṃkilesaṃ. kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ nekkhamme ānisaṃsaṃ vodānapakkhaṃ.
mn60:8.1: santaṃyeva kho pana paraṃ lokaṃ natthi paro lokotissa diṭṭhi hoti, sāssa hoti micchādiṭṭhi,
mn60:8.2: santaṃyeva kho pana paraṃ lokaṃ natthi paro lokoti saṅkappeti, svāssa hoti micchāsaṅkappo.
mn60:8.3: santaṃyeva kho pana paraṃ lokaṃ natthi paro lokoti vācaṃ bhāsati, sāssa hoti micchāvācā.
mn60:8.4: santaṃyeva kho pana paraṃ lokaṃ natthi paro lokoti āha. ye te arahanto paralokaviduno tesamayaṃ paccanīkaṃ karoti.
mn60:8.5: santaṃyeva kho pana paraṃ lokaṃ natthi paro lokoti paraṃ saññāpeti. sāssa hoti asaddhammasaññatti
mn60:8.6: tāya ca pana asaddhammasaññattiyā attānukkaṃseti. paraṃ vambheti.
mn60:8.7: iti pubbeva kho panassa susīlyaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti, dussīlyaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ,
mn60:8.8: ayañca micchādiṭṭhi micchāsaṅkappo micchāvācā ariyānaṃ paccanīkatā asaddhammasaññatti attukkaṃsanā paravambhanā. evaṃsime aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti micchādiṭṭhipaccayā.
mn60:9.1: tatra gahapatayo, viññū puriso iti paṭisañcikkhati:
mn60:9.2: sace kho natthi paro loko evamayaṃ bhavaṃ purisapuggalo kāyassa bhedā sotthimattānaṃ karissati.
mn60:9.3: sace kho atthi paro loko evamayaṃ bhavaṃ purisapuggalo kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjissati.
mn60:9.4: kāmaṃ kho panamāhu: paro loko hotu nesaṃ bhavataṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ saccaṃ vacanaṃ.
mn60:9.5: atha ca panā’yaṃ bhavaṃ purisapuggalo diṭṭheva dhamme viññūnaṃ gārayho: dussīlo purisapuggalo micchādiṭṭhi natthikavādoti.

mn60:9.7: yañca diṭṭheva dhamme viññūnaṃ gārayho, yañca kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjissati.

mn60:20.2: sace kho atthi kiriyā evamayaṃ bhavaṃ purisapuggalo kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjissati.
mn60:20.3: kāmaṃ kho panamāhu kiriyā, hotu nesaṃ bhavataṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ saccaṃ vacanaṃ.
mn60:20.4: atha ca panā’yaṃ bhavaṃ purisapuggalo diṭṭheva dhamme viññūnaṃ pāsaṃso sīlavā purisapuggalo sammādiṭṭhi kiriyavādoti.
mn60:20.5: sace kho attheva kiriyā, evaṃ imassa bhoto purisapuggalassa ubhayattha kaṭaggaho,
mn60:20.6: yañca diṭṭheva dhamme viññūnaṃ pāsaṃso, yañca kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjissati.
mn60:20.7: evamassāyaṃ apaṇṇako dhammo susamatto samādinno ubhayaṃsaṃ pharitvā tiṭṭhati. riñcati akusalaṃ ṭhānaṃ.
mn60:21.1: santi gahapatayo eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino:
mn60:21.2: natthi hetu natthi paccayo sattānaṃ saṅkilesāya,
mn60:21.4: natthi hetu, natthi paccayo sattānaṃ visuddhiyā
mn60:21.6: natthi balaṃ natthi viriyaṃ natthi purisathāmo natthi purisaparakkamo.
mn60:21.7: sabbe sattā sabbe pāṇā sabbe bhūtā sabbe jīvā avasā abalā aviriyā niyatisaṃgatibhāvapariṇatā chasvevābhijātīsu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedentīti.
mn60:22.1: tesaṃ yeva kho gahapatayo, samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā ujuvipaccanīkavādā,
mn60:22.3: atthi hetu atthi paccayo sattānaṃ saṃkilesāya,
mn60:22.7: atthi balaṃ, atthi viriyaṃ, atthi purisathāmo, atthi purisaparakkamo,
mn60:22.8: na sabbe sattā sabbe pāṇā sabbe bhūtā sabbe jīvā avasā abalā aviriyā niyatisaṃgatibhāvapariṇatā chassevābhijātisu sukhadukkhaṃ paṭisaṃvedentīti.
mn60:23.1: tatra gahapatayo ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino:
mn60:23.7: tesametaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ: yamidaṃ kāyasucaritaṃ, vacīsucaritaṃ, manosucaritaṃ, ime tayo kusale dhamme abhinivajjetvā yamidaṃ kāyaduccaritaṃ, vacīduccaritaṃ, manoduccaritaṃ. ime tayo akusale dhamme samādāya vattissanti.
mn60:23.9: na hi te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā passanti akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṅkilesaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ nekkhamme ānisaṃsaṃ vodānapakkhaṃ.
mn60:24.1: santaṃyeva kho pana hetu natthi hetū’tissa diṭṭhi hoti. sāssa hoti micchādiṭṭhi.
mn60:24.2: santaṃyeva kho pana hetu natthi hetū’ti saṅkappeti. svāssa hoti micchāsaṅkappo.
mn60:24.3: santaṃyeva kho pana hetu natthi hetū’ti vācaṃ bhāsati. sāssa hoti micchāvācā.
mn60:24.4: santaṃ yeva kho pana hetu natthi hetū’ti āha. ye te arahanto hetuvādā tesamayaṃ paccanīkaṃ karoti.
mn60:24.5: santaṃyeva kho pana hetu natthi hetū’ti paraṃ saññāpeti. sāssa hoti asaddhammasaññatti.
mn60:24.6: tāya ca pana asaddhammasaññattiyā attānukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti.
mn60:24.7: iti pubbe va kho panassa susīlyaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti, dussīlyaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ.
mn60:24.8: ayañca micchādiṭṭhi micchāsaṅkappo micchāvācā ariyānaṃ paccanīkatā asaddhammasaññatti attukkaṃsanā paravambhanā: evaṃsime aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti micchādiṭṭhipaccayā.
mn60:25.2: sace kho natthi hetu: evamayaṃ bhavaṃ purisapuggalo kāyassa bhedā sotthimattānaṃ karissati,
mn60:25.3: sace kho atthi hetu, evamayaṃ bhavaṃ purisapuggalo kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjissati.
mn60:25.4: kāmaṃ kho pana māhu hetu. hotu nesaṃ bhavataṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ saccaṃ vacanaṃ.
mn60:25.5: atha ca panāyaṃ bhavaṃ purisapuggalo diṭṭheva dhamme viññūnaṃ gārayho dussīlo purisapuggalo micchādiṭṭhi ahetuvādo’ti
mn60:25.6: sace kho attheva hetu. evaṃ imassa bhoto purisapuggalassa ubhayattha kaliggaho:
mn60:25.7: yañca diṭṭheva dhamme viññūnaṃ gārayho, yañca kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjissati.
mn60:25.8: evamassāyaṃ apaṇṇako dhammo dussamatto samādinno ekaṃsaṃ pharitvā tiṭṭhati. riñcati kusalaṃ ṭhānaṃ.
mn60:26.1: tatra gahapatayo ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino:
mn60:26.7: tesametaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ: yamidaṃ kāyaduccaritaṃ, vacīduccaritaṃ, manoduccaritaṃ, ime tayo akusale dhamme abhinivajjetvā. yamidaṃ kāyasucaritaṃ, vacīsucaritaṃ, manosucaritaṃ, ime tayo kusale dhamme samādāya vattissanti.
mn60:26.9: passanti hi te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṅkilesaṃ, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ nekkhamme ānisaṃsaṃ vodānapakkhaṃ.

mn60:29.1: santi gahapatayo eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino:
mn60:30.1: tesaṃyeva kho gahapatayo samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā ujuvipaccanīkavādā.
mn60:31.1: tatra gahapatayo viññū puriso iti paṭisañcikkhati:
mn60:31.2: ye kho te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino
mn60:31.4: yepi te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino
mn60:31.6: ahañceva kho pana ajānanto apassanto ekaṃsena ādāya vohareyyaṃ:
mn60:31.8: ye kho te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃ vādino evaṃdiṭṭhino
mn60:31.9: ‘natthi sabbaso āruppā’ti. sace tesaṃ bhavataṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ saccaṃ vacanaṃ. ṭhānametaṃ vijjati.
mn60:31.10: ye te devā rūpino manomayā apaṇṇakamme tatruppatti bhavissati.
mn60:31.11: ye pana te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃ vādino evaṃ diṭṭhino
mn60:31.12: ‘atthi sabbaso āruppā’ti. sace tesaṃ bhavataṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ saccaṃ vacanaṃ. ṭhānametaṃ vijjati.
mn60:31.13: ye te devā arūpino saññāmayā, apaṇṇakamme tatruppatti bhavissati.
mn60:31.14: dissante kho pana rūpādhikaraṇaṃ daṇḍādānasatthādāna - kalaha - viggaha -vivādatuvantuvampesuññamusāvādā.
mn60:31.16: so iti paṭisaṅkhāya rūpānaṃyeva nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
mn60:32.1: santi gahapatayo eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃ vādino evaṃ diṭṭhino:
mn60:33.1: tesaṃyeva kho gahapatayo, samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā ujuvipaccanīkavādā
mn60:34.1: tatra gahapatayo, viññū puriso iti paṭisañcikkhati:
mn60:34.2: ye kho te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino: evaṃdiṭṭhino:
mn60:34.3: natthi sabbaso bhavanirodho’ti. idaṃ me adiṭṭhaṃ,
mn60:34.4: yepi te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃ vādino evaṃ diṭṭhino:
mn60:34.6: ahañceva kho pana ajānanto apassanto ekaṃsena ādāya vohareyyaṃ:
mn60:34.7: idameva saccaṃ moghamañña’nti. na metaṃ assa patirūpaṃ
mn60:34.8: ye kho te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃ vādino evaṃ diṭṭhino
mn60:34.9: ‘natthi sabbaso bhavanirodho’ti sace tesaṃ bhavataṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ saccaṃ vacanaṃ. ṭhānametaṃ vijjati.
mn60:34.10: ye te devā arūpino saññāmayā apaṇṇakamme tatruppatti bhavissati.
mn60:34.11: ye pana te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino
mn60:34.12: ‘atthi sabbaso bhavanirodho’ti. sace tesaṃ bhavataṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ saccaṃ vacanaṃ. ṭhānametaṃ vijjati
mn60:34.14: ye kho te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃ vādino evaṃ diṭṭhino:
mn60:34.15: ‘natthi sabbaso bhavanirodho’ti. tesamayaṃ diṭṭhi sārāgāya santike, saṃyogāya santike, abhinandanāya santike, ajjhosānāya santike, upādānāya santike.
mn60:34.16: ye pana te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino:
mn60:34.17: ‘atthi sabbaso bhavanirodho’ti. tesamayaṃ diṭṭhi asārāgāya santike, asaṃyogāya santike, anabhinandanāya santike, anajjhosānāya santike, anupādānāya santiketi.
mn60:34.18: so itipaṭisaṅkhāya bhavānaṃyeva nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
mn60:35.1: cattārome gahapatayo, puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
mn60:35.3: idha gahapatayo, ekacco puggalo attantapo hoti attaparitāpanānuyogaṃ anuyutto.
mn60:35.4: idha gahapatayo, ekacco puggalo parantapo hoti paraparitāpanānuyogaṃ anuyutto.
mn60:35.5: idha gahapatayo, ekacco puggalo attantapo ca hoti attaparitāpanānuyogaṃ anuyutto, parantapo ca paraparitāpanānuyogaṃ anuyutto.
mn60:35.6: idha gahapatayo, ekacco puggalo nevattantapo hoti nāttaparitāpanānuyogaṃ anuyutto, na parantapo na paraparitāpanānuyogaṃ anuyutto.
mn60:35.7: so anattantapo aparantapo diṭṭheva dhamme nicchāto nibbuto sītībhūto sukhapaṭisaṃvedī brahmabhūtena attanā viharati.
mn60:36.1: katamo ca gahapatayo, puggalo attantapo attaparitāpanānuyogaṃ anuyutto:
mn60:36.2: idha gahapatayo, ekacco puggalo acelako hoti muttācāro hatthāpalekhano …pe…
mn60:36.3: iti evarūpaṃ anekavihitaṃ kāyassa ātāpanaparitāpanānuyogaṃ anuyutto viharati.
mn60:36.4: ayaṃ vuccati gahapatayo, puggalo attantapo attaparitāpanānuyogaṃ anuyutto.
mn60:37.1: katamo ca gahapatayo, puggalo parantapo paraparitāpanānuyogaṃ anuyutto:
mn60:37.2: idha gahapatayo, ekacco puggalo orabbhiko hoti. sūkariko …pe… ye vā panaññepi keci kurūrakammantā.
mn60:37.3: ayaṃ vuccati gahapatayo, puggalo parantapo paraparitāpanānuyogaṃ anuyutto.
mn60:38.1: katamo ca gahapatayo, puggalo attantapo ca attaparitāpanānuyogaṃ anuyutto, parantapo ca paraparitāpanānuyogaṃ anuyutto:
mn60:38.2: idha gahapatayo, ekacco puggalo rājā vā hoti khattiyo muddhāvasitto …pe…
mn60:38.3: tepi daṇḍatajjitā bhayatajjitā assumukhā rudamānā parikammāni karonti.
mn60:38.4: ayaṃ vuccati gahapatayo, puggalo attantapo ca attaparitāpanānuyogaṃ anuyutto, parantapo ca paraparitāpanānuyogaṃ anuyutto.
mn60:39.1: katamo ca gahapatayo, puggalo nevattantapo nāttaparitāpanānuyogaṃ anuyutto na parantapo na paraparitāpanānuyogaṃ anuyutto,
mn60:39.2: so anattantapo aparantapo diṭṭheva dhamme nicchāto nibbuto sītībhūto sukhapaṭisaṃvedī brahmabhūtena attanā viharati.
mn60:40-54.1: idha gahapatayo, tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho
mn60:40-54.3: so ime pañcanīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe
mn60:40-54.4: vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ …pe…
mn60:55.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmeti.
mn60:55.2: so anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati. seyyathidaṃ: ekampi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo …pe… iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
mn60:55.3: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte sattānaṃ cutūpapātañāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmeti.
mn60:55.4: so dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate yathākammūpage satte pajānāti.
mn60:55.5: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte āsavānaṃ khayañāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmeti.
mn60:55.8: tassa evaṃ jānato evaṃ passato kāmāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati. bhavāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati. avijjāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati.
mn60:55.10: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāti.
mn60:56.1: ayaṃ vuccati gahapatayo, puggalo nevattantapo nāttaparitāpanānuyogaṃ anuyutto, na parantapo na paraparitāpanānuyogaṃ anuyutto.
mn60:56.2: so anattantapo aparantapo diṭṭheva dhamme nicchāto nibbuto sītībhūto sukhapaṭisaṃvedī brahmabhūtena attanā viharatīti.
mn60:57.1: evaṃ vutte sāleyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
mn60:57.2: abhikkantaṃ bho gotama, abhikkantaṃ bho gotama.
mn60:57.3: seyyathāpi bho gotama, nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya, cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantīti. evamevaṃ bhotā gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
mn60:57.4: ete mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāma dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
mn60:57.5: upāsake no bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gateti.
